name: Anakin - Create Monitor
description: Create a scheduled website monitor with Anakin (https://anakin.io) -- checks a URL/site/Wire action on a schedule and records changes, optionally alerting a webhook or email.

properties.label: Anakin API Key
properties.description: Paste a secret reference, e.g. {{secrets.ANAKIN_API_KEY}}, rather than a raw key. Get a free key (300 credits, no card required) at anakin.io/dashboard.

properties.label: URL
properties.description: The URL to watch (root URL for site scope; the Wire site's URL for wire scope).

properties.label: Interval (minutes)
properties.description: Check frequency in minutes. Minimum 15.

properties.label: Scope
properties.description: What to monitor: "page" (default), "site", or "wire".

properties.label: Watch Mode
properties.description: "full_page" (2 credits/check, compares the whole page) or "specific_data" (3 credits/check, extracts only the Output Schema fields with AI). Defaults to full_page.

properties.label: Watch Format
properties.description: Format compared in full_page mode: markdown, html, or cleaned_html. Defaults to markdown.

properties.label: Output Schema (JSON Schema)
properties.description: JSON Schema of the fields to track. Required when Watch Mode is specific_data. FEEL context expression.

properties.label: AI Mode
properties.description: AI meaningful-change filtering: ignores trivial noise (ads, timestamps) and summarizes real changes. +1 credit per check.

properties.label: AI Goal
properties.description: Natural-language description of which changes count as meaningful (used with AI Mode), e.g. "only when the price drops or it goes out of stock".

properties.label: Use Browser
properties.description: Render checks with a stealth headless browser (needed for JS-heavy pages). Forced true server-side when Session ID is set.

properties.label: Country
properties.description: Two-letter proxy country code. Defaults to "us".

properties.label: Session ID
properties.description: Saved browser-session ID for monitoring login-protected pages (see Session List).

properties.label: Active
properties.description: Start running immediately. Defaults to true.

properties.label: Expires At
properties.description: Optional end date (ISO 8601 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD); the monitor auto-pauses when it passes.

properties.label: Alert Webhook URL
properties.description: Webhook URL that receives signed change alerts.

properties.label: Alert Emails
properties.description: Comma-separated email recipients for change alerts.

properties.label: Max Pages
properties.description: Site scope: max pages crawled per run.

properties.label: Max Depth
properties.description: Site scope: crawl depth (1-5). Defaults to 2.

properties.label: Include Patterns
properties.description: Site scope: glob patterns or hand-picked same-site URLs to track. FEEL list expression.

properties.label: Exclude Patterns
properties.description: Site scope: glob patterns to skip. FEEL list expression.

properties.label: Wire Action ID
properties.description: Wire scope (required there): the Wire action run each check, e.g. "amazon.search_products" (see Wire Discover).

properties.label: Wire Catalog Slug
properties.description: Wire scope: catalog slug of the Wire site.

properties.label: Wire Credential ID
properties.description: Wire scope: credential ID when the action needs auth (see Wire Identities).

properties.label: Wire Params
properties.description: Wire scope: parameters passed to the action each check. FEEL context expression.

properties.label: Wire Watch Paths
properties.description: Wire scope: JSON paths to diff instead of the whole response. FEEL list expression.

properties.label: Version
properties.description: Version of the element template

properties.label: ID
properties.description: ID of the element template

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in

properties.label: Result expression
properties.description: Expression to map the response into process variables

properties.label: Error expression
properties.description: Expression to handle errors. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Retries
properties.description: Number of retries

properties.label: Retry backoff
properties.description: ISO-8601 duration to wait between retries
